root.title: AI Calorie & Nutrition Tracker: Describe Your Meal / Kallo
root.description: Type what you ate the way you'd say it. Kallo counts calories, protein, carbs and fat from USDA and FAO food data, and asks when a portion is unclear. First 30 days of Premium on us.

organization.description: Kallo is an AI calorie and macro tracker: describe a meal in your own words and get calories and macros, grounded in USDA, FAO and Vietnam's national food composition table.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Kallo plans and prices. Start free, upgrade to Premium for AI logging, label scanning, micronutrients and unlimited circles.
